header: Everything the dispatch desk handles before 08:00
subheadline: Six o'clock in the morning: two sick calls, one broken-down van and a chiller failure at a food plant in Wels. These are the four things a dispatcher has to settle before the first crew leaves the yard.

items.title: Reassign without phoning around
items.description: Drag a job to another technician and the mobile app updates in under two seconds. Nobody is called twice, and nobody drives to a call that was already covered.

items.title: Protect the SLA clock
items.description: Contracted response windows sit on every job. The board warns 30 minutes before a breach, so the escalation happens while there is still time to move somebody.

items.title: See van stock before promising a part
items.description: Parts on each van are counted at close-out, so a dispatcher knows whether the compressor is 15 minutes away or three days out before committing to a time.

items.title: Hand over the shift in writing
items.description: The evening handover lists open calls, parts on order and anything the night crew inherits. It is generated from the board, not typed from memory.
